articles.summary: Qualified customers may now purchase the Niagen ™ At-Home Injection Kit on www.niagenplus.com using HSA/FSA funds with Truemed Niagen Bioscience, Inc. (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced that it has partnered with Truemed to provide qualified customers the option to purchase the Niagen ™ At-Home Injection Kit using Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) funds, now available through its Niagen™ Plus telehealth platform. Qualified customers may use HSA/FSA funds to purchase the Niagen At-Home Injection Kit by selecting the Truemed (Pay with HSA/FSA) option at checkout. articles.summary: Dr. Abhijit Kale to outline the next phase of the Niagen Research Program Niagen Bioscience, Inc.
